description:
We are Computer Science and Engineering students interested in technology, innovation, and problem-solving. Our interests include AI/ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and Web Development. We have basic skills in Python, Java, C, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL.

We welcome enthusiastic team members with skills in programming, AI/ML, web development, UI/UX design, and creative problem-solving. We value collaboration, creativity, and a willingness to learn and build meaningful solutions together!
